What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the skill everyone praises was learned to survive one specific person unless you give them a reason to say it first. If that truth surfaces at Mossgate ossuary cellar, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
